The analysis of peptides by mass spectrometry will depend on the type of instrument/platform used. Typical instrument settings for analysis on a Thermo Fusion Lumos instrument are provided in the following section. Inject 3 µL for each LC–MS/MS analysis using available mass spectrometer with a 120-minute online LC separation.

Separate the peptides on a 100 μm inner diameter microcapillary column packed in house with ~ 35 cm of Accucore150 resin ( 2.6 μm , 150 Å, ThermoFisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) with a gradient consisting of 5%–21% (ACN, 0.1% FA) over a total 02:30:00 run at ~ 500 nL/min . Details of typical instrument parameters are provided below. For Multi-Notch MS3-based TMT analysis3, the scan sequence began with an MS1 spectrum (Orbitrap analysis; resolution 60,000 at 200 Th; mass range 375−1500 m/z; automatic gain control (AGC) target 5Å~105; maximum injection time 50 ms) unless otherwise stated in the instrument parameters in each supplemental table.
Data analysis will be platform and purpose specific.

steps.title: Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Grow cells (e.g., HeLa with or without the GRN gene) expressing TMEM192-3xHA in DMEM containing 10% FBS. Use one 15 cm plate per replicate at 80% confluence.

steps.title: Cell Harvesting and Lysis
steps.instruction: Harvest and lyse the cells to prepare the protein extract.

substeps.instruction: Pellet cells at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Wash cells once with KPBS buffer (136 mM KCL, 10 mM KH2PO4, pH 7.2).
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL KPBS buffer.
Lyse using 30 strokes in a 2 mL Potter-Elvehjem homogenizer.
Spin down lysed cells at 1000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the pellet.

steps.title: Lysosome Purification via Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Isolate TMEM192-3xHA lysosomes using anti-HA magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Determine protein concentration of the lysate using Bradford assay.
Normalize protein concentration across replicates; save 5% of the input sample.
Add 30-50 µL of anti-HA magnetic beads to the remainder of the sample.
Place mixture on gentle rotation for 1 hour at 4 °C.
Separate beads from lysate using a magnetic stand.
Wash beads twice with KPBS containing 300 mM NaCl and once with KPBS buffer.
Elute samples with 100 µL KPBS containing 0.5% (v/v) NP-40 in a thermo mixer at 4 °C for 30 minutes.
Snap freeze elutes in liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Protein Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Prepare the eluted proteins for digestion.

substeps.instruction: Reduce lysates for 30 minutes at 25 °C (Room temperature) with 5 mM TCEP.
Alkylate cysteine residues with 20 mM Chloroacetamide for 30 minutes at Room temperature.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation and Washing
steps.instruction: Clean the protein samples using TCA and methanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add TCA to eluates to a final concentration of 20% and place on ice at 4 °C for at least 1 hour.
Pellet proteins by centrifugation at maximum speed for 30 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully aspirate supernatant, leaving ~30-40 µL of solution to avoid disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend pellets in 4 volumes of ice cold 10% TCA and pellet by centrifugation at 4 °C for 10 minutes at maximum speed; aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 4 volumes of ice cold methanol and pellet by centrifugation at 4 °C for 10 minutes at maximum speed; aspirate supernatant.
Repeat the methanol wash.
Aspirate methanol and air dry the remaining 30-40 µL of solution (or use a speed-vac).

steps.title: Peptide Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform sequential enzymatic digestion of the dried pellets.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend dried pellets in 50 µL of 200 mM EPPS, pH 8.0.
Digest with LysC (0.25 µg) for 2 hours at 37 °C.
Follow with trypsin (0.5 µg) digestion overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: TMT Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the peptides using TMT reagents.

substeps.instruction: Add 3-4 µL of TMT reagent and 15 µL of 100% ACN to each 50 µL sample.
Incubate for 1 hour at Room temperature.
Stop the reaction with 4 µL of 5% hydroxylamine for 15 minutes at Room temperature.
Resuspend samples in 100 µL of 5% FA, 5% ACN and verify pH is ~3 or lower using pH strips.
Wash C-18 with 100 µL of 100% methanol.
Equilibrate C-18 with 50 µL of 50% ACN 5% FA.
Equilibrate C-18 with 100 µL of 5% ACN 5% FA.
Load sample onto C-18 to bind peptides.
Wash bound peptides with 50 µL of 5% ACN 5% FA.
Elute peptides with 50 µL of 75% ACN/5% FA.
Re-constitute peptides in 10 µL of 5% ACN 5% FA.

steps.title: Mass Spectrometry Data Acquisition
steps.instruction: Analyze peptides using an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer coupled to a Proxeon EASY-nLC1200 LC pump.

substeps.instruction: Use elution gradient: 17.5%, 20%, 22.5%, 25%, 27.5%, and 70% ACN.
Select precursors for MS2 analysis using a Top10 method (CID; quadrupole ion trap; Turbo scan rate; AGC 2.0E4; isolation window 0.7 Th; NCE 35; max injection time 90 ms).
Use monoisotopic peak assignment and exclude previously interrogated precursors using a dynamic window (150 s ± 7898 ppm), performing dependent scans on a single charge state per precursor.
Collect a synchronous-precursor-selection (SPS) MS3 scan on the top 10 most intense ions in the MS2 spectrum.
Fragment MS3 precursors by high energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) and analyze using the Orbitrap (NCE 65; AGC 3E5; max injection time 150 ms; resolution 50,000 at 200 Th).

steps.title: Proteomic Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Process raw MS data to identify proteins and calculate ratios.

substeps.instruction: Search raw data against UniProt human protein database.
Set parameters: Up to 3 missed cleavages (trypsin/LysC); Fixed modifications: Carbamidomethyl (C), TMT (N-term peptide and K); Variable modifications: Oxidation (M).
Extract signal to noise intensity values for each TMT reporter and identified protein.
Calculate the ratio of each condition to the control sample's intensity.
